prompts.map:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: production village game map, same 1536 x 1024 landscape canvas.
Edit target: the supplied complete illustrated Breton village map.
Primary request: rename and transform ONLY the lower-left library building into "QuizzShow", a friendly village quiz-show venue. Keep its exact position and silhouette: slate roof with small turret, cream stone walls, right-hand arched wooden door, hydrangeas and doorstep. Match the original bold irregular black ink outlines, simple flat printed cream/teal/gold/apricot palette and whimsical cartoon architecture.
Replace the big golden wooden question-mark hanging sign on this building with a matching irregular golden wooden hanging sign bearing the exact single word "QuizzShow", capital Q and S, two z letters: Q-u-i-z-z-S-h-o-w. One readable line of dark teal hand-lettering. Keep the sign in approximately the same bounds x218..378, y748..801 and attached with two short dark loops; keep the outer edge simple and closed so the sign can be animated independently.
Turn the large front bookshelf window into a little quiz-show stage with four small clearly separated buzzer lecterns behind the glass, framed by warm apricot curtains and tiny warm bulb lights. No people. Replace the open-book roof emblem with a simple gold question-mark badge and a couple of small star accents, and the books in the little roof turret with a charming standing microphone. The small pavement bookstand becomes a matching quiz-show placard with a question mark, no extra words.
Preserve the village's existing welcoming hand-painted character, not a modern city television studio. Preserve camera, scale, footprint and all paths. The other seven buildings, shore, trees, bridge, river, market, card shop and every surrounding object stay unchanged. No other text added, no UI, no watermark. Return the entire map at the original 3:2 composition.
